skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of supply chain management in agribusiness, including the actors involved, internal issues, and support systems.
Analyze and explain economic relationships in agribusiness supply chain management.
Recognize and adhere to legal regulations in agribusiness supply chain management.
Work effectively in teams to address supply chain management issues.
Identify and solve problems in agribusiness supply chain management.
Evaluate and compare the effectiveness of support systems in agribusiness supply chain management.
Effectively present and discuss supply chain management issues.
Conduct research and gather data on supply chain management issues.
Understand logistics in the context of agribusiness supply chain management.
Identify and manage risks in agribusiness supply chain management.
Understand and manage quality issues in agribusiness supply chain management.
Understand the role of infrastructure in agribusiness supply chain management.
Understand the role of IT in agribusiness supply chain management.
Understand the role of government in agribusiness supply chain management.
